name: AriaOS Free Antivirus (ClamAV Engine, Shield & Whitelist)
description: 100% free, open-source ClamAV antivirus engine fully visible and controllable by AriaOS: inspects configuration & On-Access shield (clamonacc), manages AriaOS trusted SHA-256 whitelist (.fp) and ExcludePath rules so ClamAV never blocks Aria, reads AV logs, scans files, updates signatures, and isolates threats into a system-protected quarantine vault.

tools.name: av_status
tools.description: Inspect ClamAV engine binaries, signature database freshness, systemd services, and quarantine count.

tools.name: av_scan_path
tools.description: Scan a file or directory for malware using ClamAV (clamdscan if running, otherwise clamscan).

tools.name: av_update_signatures
tools.description: Update free ClamAV malware signature databases via freshclam.

tools.name: av_quarantine_list
tools.description: List all files currently isolated in the AriaOS antivirus quarantine vault.

tools.name: av_quarantine_file
tools.description: Isolate a suspicious or infected file into the reversible AriaOS quarantine vault without deleting it.

path.description: File path to isolate in quarantine.

reason.description: Detected threat name or reason for isolation.

tools.name: av_restore_file
tools.description: Restore a quarantined file back to its original path (fails safely if a file already exists there).

tools.name: av_get_config
tools.description: Inspect live ClamAV daemon settings (clamd.conf), AriaOS exclusions (ExcludePath / OnAccessExcludeRootUID), trusted SHA-256 whitelist (.fp), and On-Access real-time shield status.

tools.name: av_read_logs
tools.description: Read recent ClamAV scan, freshclam update, and On-Access shield events from /var/log/clamav or systemd journal.

tools.name: av_set_exclusion
tools.description: Add or remove a managed ClamAV path exclusion in clamd.conf or certify a verified file hash into ClamAV's native trusted SHA-256 whitelist (ariaos-trusted.fp).

target.description: Directory/regex path or binary file path to whitelist by SHA-256.

tools.name: av_shield_control
tools.description: Check, start, stop, or reload ClamAV's resident daemon (clamav-daemon) and real-time On-Access shield (clamav-clamonacc).
